feedback: PRD authored for REQ-000024: refactor hello.py to expose greet(name='world') returning 'hello <name>', preserve CLI behavior of `python hello.py` printing 'hello world', and add pytest unit tests for greet() (default + custom name) while keeping the existing subprocess test intact. Includes goals, non-goals, 4 user stories, 13 functional requirements, 7 acceptance tests, NFRs, risks, open questions, and a traceability matrix.
